title: Reproducing Song et al. 2004: dry oxidation of three faces of 4H-SiC

sample.paper: “~5 mm x 5 mm, cut from a double-side polished (0001)/(000-1) oriented (research grade, n type, on axis), and (11-20) oriented … wafers, supplied by CREE Inc.”
sample.note: The polytype, 4H, is given only in the abstract, captions and conclusion.

sample.paper: n type; concentration not stated; no epilayer mentioned
sample.ours: DOPING: n_type (recorded; no program reads it)

sample.paper: “the native oxide thickness … is only about 2 Å for all of the C, a, and Si faces”; the fits set the time offset to zero
sample.ours: the oxide starts at zero thickness

sample.note: The later SiC electrical paper we use (Kobayashi 2017) is 4° off-axis; the language cannot tell the two apart.

sample.paper: the two faces of one double-side polished wafer
sample.note: Whether both faces of one piece were oxidized together is not stated.

history.paper: “Samples were cleaned by acetone, methanol and 5% HF solution in successive steps.”
history.note: The vocabulary's cleans are silicon cleans; none is a solvent clean followed by HF.

history.item: Loaded at once into the furnace
history.paper: “Immediately after this cleaning, the samples were loaded into the oxidation furnace.”

history.item: Time in oxygen at 1150 °C before the clock starts
history.paper: not stated: “Immediately after this cleaning, the samples were loaded into the oxidation furnace.”
history.ours: RUN BeforeClock DURATION 1 TEMP 1150->1150 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: An offset of time zero: oxygen reaching the sample before the plotted time begins (a push in oxygen, a ramp counted as zero). 1 s, i.e. none, is the reproduction's value; searched from 1 s to 30 min. A clock that starts before the oxygen arrives is the opposite sign and is tried as a variant.

history.paper: “A Lindberg high temperature furnace was used for dry oxidation at atmospheric pressure. The oxygen flow rate was 1 l/min … between 950 and 1150 °C for different oxidation times.”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 21600 TEMP 1150->1150 AMBIENT dry_O2
the history ends when the oxidation ends
history.note: No cooling, no anneal after oxidation: the paper describes none.

history.paper: “He+ ions of 1.8 MeV … Rutherford backscattering”; “also measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry as a complimentary technique”
history.note: The figures do not say which technique's values were plotted and fitted.
